model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates responses to a survey question in Bulgarian asking which measures respondents consider most important for limiting the "hidden economy" in the country. The vertical axis lists 13 categories of proposed measures, while the horizontal axis represents percentage values, though no explicit scale or axis label is shown; values are annotated at the end of each bar. The bars are colored in two tones — muted red (brick/dark rose) and steel blue — though no legend is provided to explain the color distinction. Starting from the top, "Да се засили граничния контрол" (Strengthen border control) appears as a blue bar at approximately 2%, followed by "Да се ограничат действията на мафията" (Limit mafia activities) as a red bar at 10%, and "Да се облекчат условията за получаване на кредит" (Ease credit conditions) as a blue bar at 3%. "Да се намали корупцията" (Reduce corruption) is a red bar and appears to be one of the longest, though its exact percentage is not annotated. "Да се подобри качеството на административните..." (Improve the quality of administrative [services]) is a red bar at 13%. "Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система" (Increase judicial system effectiveness) is a red bar that also appears among the longest, without an annotated value. "Да се засили данъчния контрол" (Strengthen tax control) is a blue bar at 9%. "Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса" (Introduce more effective business incentives) is a red bar and appears to be the longest or near-longest in the chart, also without an annotated value. "Да се приемат по-строги закони" (Adopt stricter laws) is a blue bar at 5%, "Да се намалят акцизите" (Reduce excise duties) is a blue bar at 2%, "Да се намали ДДС" (Reduce VAT) is a blue bar at 5%, "Да се намали данъка върху печалбата" (Reduce profit tax) is a blue bar at 3%, and "Да се намали личния подоходен данък" (Reduce personal income tax) is a blue bar at 3%. The shortest bars correspond to the categories at 2% (border control and excise duties), while the longest bars appear to be the unannotated red bars for reducing corruption, increasing judicial effectiveness, and introducing business incentives. The bars are not sorted in ascending or descending order but appear in a fixed categorical arrangement, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond the color distinction.
